content.text: Affected customers from the last two weeks notified via support.
After an escalation handoff, notification email still goes to the previous owner instead of the new assignee.
The handoff updates the ticket owner field but the escalation mailer reads a cached owner snapshot from the escalation record.
Refresh the owner snapshot on handoff and resend any misdirected notifications identified in the audit window.

description_text:
After an escalation handoff, notification email still goes to the previous owner instead of the new assignee.
The handoff updates the ticket owner field but the escalation mailer reads a cached owner snapshot from the escalation record.
Refresh the owner snapshot on handoff and resend any misdirected notifications identified in the audit window.
